const source = { get value() { return 1; } };
const copy = { ...source };
copy.value = 2;
console.log(copy.value);
let stored = 0;
const both = {
  get size(): number { return stored; },
  set size(v: string | number) { stored = Number(v); },
};
const copied = { ...both, extra: true };
copied.size = 5;
console.log(copied.size, both.size);
class Box { get width() { return 3; } }
const fromClass = { ...{ get height() { return 4; } }, w: new Box().width };
fromClass.height = 9;
console.log(fromClass);
const maybe = stored > 2 ? source : { value: 7 };
const unionCopy = { ...maybe };
unionCopy.value = 8;
console.log(unionCopy.value);
